text: ## Corrupted **Preserved Core text:** Healing is reduced, corruption-sensitive effects worsen, and long rests may shift behavior or form until cleansed. **Effect:** Halve each healing effect's final potential HP once, rounded down, before the HP ceiling. Saves against spells/abilities from individually recorded Evil creatures have disadvantage; its aura can be detected by effects revealing evil. At each completed long rest make DC 15 WIS save or move one moral step Good to Neutral to Evil, leaving law/chaos unchanged. Already Evil remains Evil. Alignment does not compel conduct, party separation, PvP or automatic oathbreaking. **Application:** Only effects that explicitly inflict Corrupted apply it. **Duration and ending:** Persists until an explicit cleansing effect or the eight-hour cleansing project in CONDITION_RECOVERY_PLAYTEST.md succeeds. Long rest alone does not cleanse it. At a simultaneous cleansing/rest endpoint, resolve cleansing first and make the Corrupted rest save only if it remains. **Stacking:** Corrupted does not stack with itself. Apply the generic half-healing reduction once; an effect does not halve again merely because it restates the same Corrupted penalty. **Immunities and specific exceptions:** Natural-20 death-save recovery and recovered Stable 1-HP recovery are state-recovery rules rather than healing effects and still restore exactly 1 HP. Explicit cleansing or protection may override within scope. **Compatible V6/source details:** - V6: healing effects restore half normal HP; disadvantage on saves against spells/abilities from evil creatures; faint aura detectable by magic revealing evil; at end of each long rest make DC 15 Wisdom save or alignment shifts one step toward evil. **Explicit integration decisions:** - NEW: round half healing down once; guaranteed death-save/Stable one-HP state recovery is not a healing effect. - Source-grounded: individual recorded alignment or Evil tag only; no ancestry/faction inference, forced behavior or automatic conduct violation. - NEW: generic cleansing project supplies a finite recovery route. **Remaining wider integration work:** - Cross-check separately reviewed corruption-sensitive transformations and specific restoration effects. Provenance: Core V2 `books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx`, zero-based all-XML heading paragraph 737, definition paragraph 738; both positions, exact text and book SHA-256 are verified against the approved book and retained in the [condition data](../../data/playtest/condition_playtests.json).
scope: An explicit current Corrupted application supplies an actual condition type. Application provenance must come from the actual source event; the spell must not invent a cause from alignment, species or the condition name.
